Check a pipeline spec, or print the spec's JSON Schema

```text
dspk spec [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## `dspk spec check`

Check a spec (.json or .toml) without opening its files; print its canonical JSON

```text
dspk spec check [OPTIONS] <SPEC>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<SPEC>`**

**Options**

- **`-q, --quiet`**  
  Only check; print nothing on success

## `dspk spec schema`

Print the JSON Schema of pipeline specs

```text
dspk spec schema [OPTIONS]
```
